name: get_content
title: Get content
description: Return the current HTML content of a tab. While the tab is still navigating, waits up to 5 s for the new page to reach domcontentloaded; if it is still navigating then, fails with WAIT_TIMEOUT, which is safe to retry. HTML longer than max_chars (default 100000) is cut to its first max_chars characters and the result says so (truncated, total_chars, notice); max_chars: 0 returns all of it. Web apps can be megabytes of HTML: snapshot is the readable view of a page. In a template session, text equal to a stored sign-in value that could be a secret (a cookie or site-data value) reads [sealed]; only that text is replaced, and URLs, numbers, language and time-zone names are shown as they are.

max_chars.description: At most this many characters of HTML (0 = no limit).
